name: antresol
description: Lets an AI assistant read your Antresol home inventory and prepare intake drafts from receipts and photos.
long_description: Reads your Antresol inventory (items, folders, intakes) and fills intake drafts from receipts and photos. It never commits anything: you review and commit every intake in the Antresol app.

connection_key.title: Antresol connection key
connection_key.description: Settings → Connect AI in the Antresol app.

photos_dir.title: Photos folder
photos_dir.description: Where photos of receipts and items are looked for. Leave empty for Pictures/Antresol in your home folder.
